article.title: Application of other provisions of this Act.
article.content:
158BHApplication of other provisions of this Act.

Section 158BH  ·  Chapter XIV-B  ·  page 665 of the Act
Save as otherwise provided in this Chapter, all other provisions of this Act shall apply to assessment made under this Chapter.
